scope: 2026-09-19 reference-flow implementation. Host/simulator and source evidence only; preserve existing physical/runtime gaps.

rows.surface: Reviewed HTTP proxy-list import and searchable device library
rows.mechanism: Explicit Paste reads clipboard only on tap. The parser accepts existing HTTP URL/provider formats, previews counts, duplicate endpoints and per-line errors, rejects unsupported SOCKS/HTTPS-to-proxy formats, and enforces size/line/library bounds. Save compares the current input/library to the reviewed preview, then updates one secure configuration record. Any invalid/stale/failed write leaves the library intact. Import never selects a proxy, enables traffic, changes a cloud assignment or replaces license/account data. The private list/editor retains user-requested visible URL credentials; summaries and diagnostics omit them. No QR scanner or Shadowrocket private-store import is claimed.

Existing library regressions pass. No live egress tested.
rows.fix: One secure-record atomic update is not a cross-process compare-and-swap guarantee. Keep selected-device configuration distinct from per-container cloud assignment; verify physical keyboard/clipboard flow and retain external routing acceptance.

rows.surface: Settings readiness, scoped Cloud console and transfer explanations
rows.mechanism: Settings presents existing timestamped source/license/server/network readiness and actions in cards; advanced technical details remain available. Saved HTTPS origin is not labelled connected without fresh published evidence. No MDM or network gate is removed. Cloud links use an exact registered app route and a validated HTTPS origin. Existing encrypted backup and license integration is retained; copy warns that Keychain/hardware-bound credentials do not transfer and login continuity is not guaranteed. Settings, Cloud and maintenance are absent from the locked root, rather than being accessible behind an activation sheet. Detailed Account/license controls remain reachable after a valid grant; that screen refreshes current publication on appearance, foreground and timer. The root activation screen reuses the existing configured HTTPS origin or established production default without changing signing keys.

rows.mechanism: A local searchable grouped picker replaces long action sheets. It accepts only catalog option dictionaries, deduplicates values, marks current selection, supports cancel/no-results and applies one selection. The identity editor rechecks pending request and first-use lock at selection time. Model choice keeps compatible iOS; manual language remains limited to supported regional catalog entries. No remote catalog, randomized range policy or device-wide hook is invented. Model options are now ranked against the unhooked launcher screen native pixels, logical points, display scale and native scale with orientation normalization. Exact geometry matches are recommendations; when absent, closest catalog models are explicitly labelled not exact. Existing selection never changes from ranking. Invalid/missing/boolean/nonfinite metrics cannot produce a verified match. Selecting a model still uses the unchanged compatible-iOS and identity-draft path.
rows.verification: PASS:233 UIKit editor assertions include search, current checkmarks, cancel, empty result, model/iOS compatibility, carrier/city selection and durable receipt handling across modal dismissal; this is one editor suite, not233 extra isolation checks. Existing catalog/identity validation remains separate. The original198 cases remain; native48 covers geometry and location constraints. Current catalog has no exact iPhone X geometry; no older specifications or hardware identity are invented.
rows.fix: Keep compatible catalog tuples and exact confirmation before Save. App hardware/OS values are synthetic fields, not firmware emulation; actual hook consistency needs physical evidence.

rows.surface: Organizational container rename with revisioned cloud synchronization
rows.mechanism: Rename updates only optional profile nickname as organizational metadata. ID, bundle family, installed clone name, sandbox, identity and credentials remain unchanged. Launcher, replacement/backup naming and publication prefer a validated optional label with existing central-store fallback. Partial name/role/notes edits preserve omitted fields; metadata revisions reject stale cloud writes and exact newer acknowledgements recover lost replies. Explicit new names are bounded and reject controls; unchanged legacy long names and canonical ID fallbacks remain accepted for synchronization. Only an exact echoed legacy nickname is omitted from native metadata application; all other raw reply validation remains strict. Existing names are never silently truncated. First publication of an existing offline legacy display name is accepted without truncation; later changed names still require current validation and exact metadata revision.
rows.verification: PASS:55 native assertions execute shipped rename/metadata methods in both app namespaces with inert persistence; metadata helper regressions cover divergent/exact name acknowledgements and exact legacy reply handling. Cloud endpoint metadata14 and inventory9 checks pass with fixture storage. UIKit workspace216 assertions include Rename, Cancel, invalid/unchanged names and search retaining the same container ID. No physical rename or Cloud production deployment is claimed.
rows.fix: Keep legacy display names and cloud revision compatibility. Verify on-device rename/display/backup roundtrip separately. A changed UI label is neither a new identity nor proof of isolation.
